$Comment: The restless graveyard, the full moon's endless run: the Headless Horseman's source prefab beside this
file (the same enclosed night graveyard, 64 by 110 blocks; players arrive at its anchor in the entrance
room), with the run's entity on the open road just south of the central plaza, the Voidtaken Horseman's
spawn marker on the plaza's north side, and a vanilla Leave_Instance pad against the entrance room's back
wall, the way out. Cells count from the anchor, and they are the Horseman's graveyard's own
(Hallows_Eve_Graveyard.json), so the waves rise on spots his hard ride already proved open floor.
The run's reach (Range and PlayerRange in its script, EncounterManager/SeasonsOfOrbis/
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard_Encounter.json) and its waves' spawn rows are measured from the run's
entity, so move them with its cell. The Voidtaken rides the Horseman's flight in the saddle
(Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ride), which measures its swings and fountain laps from where he spawns, so his
marker keeps the Horseman's cell, 7 north of the fountain's centre.
Containers stocks the source's hidden chest, in the sealed treasure room inside the west rock reached
every paste places it full again, and the first player to open it takes what it holds.
